name: EXM_MISC_POLICIES
description: This table contains all data related to a given miscellaneous policy.

columns.name: MISC_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of miscellaneous expense policy.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: POLICY_NAME
columns.description: Name of miscellaneous expense policy.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of miscellaneous expense policy.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of miscellaneous expense policy, whether Draft, Valid, Invalid, or Active. Values are from lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: ENABLED_ELIGIBILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether minimum number of days are required before miscellaneous expense is eligible for expense reimbursement.

columns.name: ELIGIBILITY_DAYS
columns.description: Minimum number of days before miscellaneous expense is eligible for reimbursement.

columns.name: DAYS_BASED_ITEM_PARENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether eligibility for miscellaneous expense reimbursement is based on number of days specified in parent line during itemization in expense entry.

columns.name: RATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Policy rate type of miscellaneous expense policy, whether by rate limit, percentage reimbursement, or percentage reimbursement with rate limit. Values are from lookup EXM_RATE_TYPE.

columns.name: SINGLE_INSTANCE_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether miscellaneous expense policy limits are enforced by each submitted instance of miscellaneous expense item.

columns.name: DAILY_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether daily amount limit of miscellaneous expenses is enforced. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: MONTHLY_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether monthly amount limit of miscellaneous expenses is enforced. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: YEARLY_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether miscellaneous expense policy limits are enforced by maximum permitted annual amount. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: LIFETIME_LIMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether miscellaneous expense policy limits are enforced by maximum permitted lifetime amount. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: PERIOD_MONTH
columns.description: Starting month from which miscellaneous expense policy annual rate limit is counted. Values are from lookup MONTH.

columns.name: PERIOD_DAY
columns.description: Start date from which miscellaneous expense policy annual rate limit is counted. Values are from lookup DAY.

columns.name: CURRENCY_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Miscellaneous expense policy defined for single currency or for multiple currencies. Values are from lookup EXM_CURRENCY_OPTION.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code for miscellaneous expense policy.

columns.name: ENABLED_ROLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether miscellaneous expense rates vary, based on employee role.

columns.name: POLICY_ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role type that determines miscellaneous expense policy rate, such as Job, Grade, or Position. Values are from lookup EXM_POLICY_ROLE.

columns.name: ENABLED_LOCATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether miscellaneous expense policy rates vary by location.

columns.name: LOCATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Location that determines miscellaneous expense policy rates, such as Geographical, Location, or Zone. Valid values are from lookup EXM_LOCATION_TYPE.

columns.name: ZONE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup that defines zone types for this miscellaneous expense policy. Values are from lookup EXM_ZONE_TYPE.

columns.name: ENABLED_GENDER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether miscellaneous rates vary based on the gender of an employee.

columns.name: POLICY_ENFORCEMENT_CODE
columns.description: Type of miscellaneous expense policy enforcement applied. Values are from lookup EXM_POLICY_ENFORCEMENT.

columns.name: POLICY_VIOLATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether employees are warned when they submit expenses that exceed defined miscellaneous expense policy rate limit.

columns.name: WARNING_TOLERANCE
columns.description: Percentage that, when added to miscellaneous expense policy amount limit, defines maximum allowable limit, resulting in policy warning violation.

columns.name: DISP_WARNING_TO_USER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether miscellaneous expense policy warning is displayed to user.

columns.name: PREVENT_SUBMISSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether expense report submission is prevented if miscellaneous expense policy violation occurs.

columns.name: ERROR_TOLERANCE
columns.description: Percentage that, when added to miscellaneous expense policy amount limit, defines maximum allowable limit, resulting in prevention of expense report submission.
